subject.title: fix(models): authenticate Anthropic discovery with OAuth tokens

question: Should successful Anthropic OAuth discovery preserve shipped manifest models while adding live rows, or is replacing the subscription user’s provider listing with the live API catalog an intended compatibility change?
rationale: The patch fixes authentication, but it newly exposes subscription users to a documented list-removal behavior; accepting that effect is a product and upgrade-policy choice rather than a mechanical auth-header decision.

options.title: Preserve shipped entries
options.body: Merge accepted live rows into the shipped Anthropic catalog so existing listed models remain available while new API models are discovered.

options.title: Accept replacement semantics
options.body: Keep the shared replacement behavior and explicitly accept that subscription users may lose manifest-only models from the live provider listing.

recommendation.title: Preserve shipped entries
recommendation.body: Merge accepted live rows into the shipped Anthropic catalog so existing listed models remain available while new API models are discovered.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently maintained the linked Anthropic live-discovery path, so they are the closest history-backed routing candidate for clarifying the intended catalog semantics.
